cli.usage:
Usage: openrent <command>

  migrate [--dry-run]                      Apply database migrations
  backup --out DIR [--with-files]          Database dump plus a manifest of stored files
  restore DIR --yes                        Replace the database with a backup, then check files
  restore DIR --check                      Only check stored files against a backup
  files migrate-storage [--tenant ID]      Move files kept in the database to object storage
  files verify [--tenant ID]               Check that stored files exist
  plugin disable|enable ID [--tenant ID]   Turn a plugin off or on for one or every shop
  plugin check [DIR] | plugin pack [DIR]   Check a plugin folder, or check it and make a ZIP for upload
  theme check [DIR] | theme pack [DIR]     Check a theme folder, or check it and make a ZIP
  theme install ZIP                        Put a code theme into THEMES_DIR (then rebuild the storefront)

Options: --pg-dump PATH, --pg-restore PATH, --batch N
